Backup.Title: Backup & Restore
Backup.Description: A backup contains the whole database plus every uploaded photo, scan and document. Keep a copy somewhere other than this computer.

Backup.Restore Description: This replaces all current data — files, contracts, visits, payments and uploaded documents — with the contents of the backup. It cannot be undone. The program will restart when the restore finishes.
